assets.name: cup
assets.prompt: Create one premium photorealistic 3D product-render asset for a luxury coffee restaurant website. An isolated beautiful ivory porcelain cappuccino cup containing dark espresso, no saucer. Three-quarter frontal view at a gentle 15 degree elevated angle, front of cup prominently visible and nearly face-on, handle on the RIGHT side. Entire cup contained in frame, generous transparent padding. Wide elegant softly rounded bowl, substantial delicate lip, small tapered base, beautiful continuous curved ceramic surfaces. The cup front MUST be completely blank and clean, no lettering, no logo, no symbols, as an exact existing brand decal will be added by the website. Dark almost black rich espresso visible in elliptical opening, very subtle thin caramel crema at perimeter. Studio lighting designed for black background: narrow icy blue rim light from upper left, cool silver-blue specular along rim and left edge, soft warm ivory fill on front so shape remains readable. Restrained, expensive, exceptionally realistic glazed ceramic, crisp silhouette, controlled highlights, rich dimensional shadows, restrained blue not neon, like a high-budget Apple product photograph. Camera roughly 70mm, no wideangle distortion. No table, no floor, no saucer, no props, no floating beans, no steam, no backdrop, no cast shadow outside object. True transparent background. Object takes about 80 percent of image width. Horizontal landscape canvas.

assets.name: saucer
assets.prompt: Create the matching SAUCER ALONE as a separate 3D product-render asset to match the ivory porcelain espresso cup in the supplied reference. No cup at all. A beautiful wide low-profile ivory ceramic coffee saucer, viewed from the same gentle elevated camera angle as the reference (about 15–20 degrees from horizontal): a wide thin ellipse, front lip visible, shallow center depression, soft beveled circular raised outer edge, subtle concentric indentation. Entire saucer centered and contained within image, fills 84 percent of image width and about 25–35 percent of image height. Exactly match the reference glazed ivory material, cool blue rim light from upper left, restrained soft champagne highlight from right. Beautiful photorealistic premium product photography, controlled specular reflections, clean realistic ivory porcelain, no cup, no coffee, no props, no lettering, no logo, no table, no floor, NO cast shadow or glow outside the ceramic. Transparent background with clean alpha. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Cup and saucer will be composited in the website; only produce a detached saucer.

assets.name: cup-empty
assets.prompt: Edit this exact cup product asset. Preserve the exact same cup, silhouette, pixel position, scale, perspective, handle, framing, lighting, ivory porcelain color and transparent background. Change ONLY what is INSIDE the bowl: all the coffee has now poured out, so show the empty ivory ceramic interior with a tiny subtle dark espresso residue at the very bottom and a faint crema stain, no pool of coffee, no full coffee surface. The interior should have natural shadows and the same porcelain material. Do not move, resize, reshape, or rotate the cup. Keep blank front, no lettering. True transparent background. This image will be crossfaded with the original, so silhouette and composition must match exactly.
